name: 1color
description: 1Color tokens (BRC-162; BRC-207; docs/1COLOR.md): one overlay topic per token, tm_color_<assetId> (the asset id <txid>_<vout>, <txid>_0 at output 0), judged by the token rules alone (color-topic), and its lookup ls_color_<assetId> (color-lookup: BRC-207's color-spendability and color-admission), both registered at runtime; the discovery topic tm_color (BRC-207 deployment discovery: every token's deploy output), the lookup service ls_color (color-lookup over whatever topics feed it: a token's unspent value outputs, its authority outputs, one output by outpoint, and over tm_color BRC-207's color-admission / color-spendability with topic tm_color: of the queried outpoints, a token's deploy tm_color admitted (the token id <txid>_<vout> IS the deploy's outpoint, <txid>.<vout>), admission spent or not; 0.12.0: ls_color_deploys is gone, no alias); every name of color-lookup reads one index, <app>/ls_color; on the overlay engine (shruggr/skein-overlay 0.16.1, required: chain/1). The overlay sync protocol, libp2p /skein/overlay/sync/1.0.0 (shruggr/skein#150), is answered through the front door by the engine's filter sync (overlay.sync) on that row (skein-overlay 0.15.0, shruggr/skein#154): a read, nothing logged. The engine's receive row, libp2p /skein/overlay/beef/1.0.0 (filter kernel.beef, handler overlay.submit; 0.11.1), takes each Atomic BEEF a catch-up fetches, handed to it by the host as from the serving peer. The token list is a read route, /<app>/color/tokens (its filter tokens, color-lookup fn tokens: anyone, nothing logged; shruggr/skein#143): {limit?, skip?} → [{tokenId, topic, sym, dec, icon?, txid, vout}], every deploy tm_color admitted, newest first; icon a binary deploy's embedded image as a data URL, a BRC-161 JSON deploy's icon string as written. The manifest declares no topics: root registers each token with the engine, two messages in the app's box register (<app>/register once installed; the handler overlay.register, gated by roles: {root: [register, registerLookup, deregisterLookup]}): {fn: "register", args: {topic: "tm_color_<assetId>", program: "color-topic", seed?}} then {fn: "registerLookup", args: {service: "ls_color_<assetId>", program: "color-lookup", topics: ["tm_color_<assetId>"]}}, and drops it with {fn: "deregisterLookup", args: {service}} then {fn: "deregister", args: {topic}}; tm_color by register alone. Every skein is a market and a validator, always (skein-overlay 0.12.0): a registered topic has liveness and a beacon on <topic>-live (its body the topic's beat: its view digest, and its tip anchor and tail digest, skein-overlay 0.14.0), a registered lookup liveness and a beacon on <service>-live. The registered sets are the heads <app>/topics and <app>/lookups. ls_color listens to every topic the overlay serves.
